content.text:
**Answer:** Two devices are low on storage. The Mac mini RLD7WV7J82SH has been below the 10% free-space threshold for the whole 30-day window. The MacBook Pro DARFCP0BQM2G has been below it since 2026-05-21. The MacBook Pro is filling at about 3.6 GB/day and could be full in about 6 days. The Mac mini's 30-day trend is about 0.5 GB/day, but its free space hasn't changed for the last 5 days.

**Evidence**
- **Mac mini RLD7WV7J82SH (emp-initech-1000), critical:** 2.0% free (5.1 GB of 256 GB) on the latest snapshot [disk_low/RLD7WV7J82SH, RLD7WV7J82SH/2026-06-12].
  - It was already at 7.5% free (19.2 GB) at the start of the window [RLD7WV7J82SH/2026-05-14].
  - **Fill rate:** the trend detector puts it at about 0.5 GB/day (slope -0.53 GB/day). It projects the disk full in about 10 days (9.7) [disk_trend/RLD7WV7J82SH].
  - **But it has stopped falling:** free space has stayed at 2.0% / 5.1 GB from 2026-06-08 to 2026-06-12 [RLD7WV7J82SH/2026-06-08, RLD7WV7J82SH/2026-06-12]. That 10-day projection may be too pessimistic. A disk this full can also stall when it's nearly out of usable space, so this still needs attention.
- **MacBook Pro DARFCP0BQM2G (emp-initech-1000), critical:** 2.0% free (20.5 GB of 1024 GB) on the latest snapshot [disk_low/DARFCP0BQM2G, DARFCP0BQM2G/2026-06-12].
  - It started the window at 12.1% free (124.4 GB) [DARFCP0BQM2G/2026-05-14] and first dropped below 10% at 9.7% on 2026-05-21 [DARFCP0BQM2G/2026-05-21].
  - **Fill rate:** about 3.6 GB/day (slope -3.63 GB/day), with 103.9 GB used over 30 snapshots. The detector projects the disk full in about 6 days (5.6) [disk_trend/DARFCP0BQM2G].
  - The decline has been steady every day across the window [DARFCP0BQM2G/2026-05-24, DARFCP0BQM2G/2026-06-02].
- No other device was flagged by either the low-disk check or the fill-rate check [disk_low/DARFCP0BQM2G, disk_low/RLD7WV7J82SH].

**Caveats**
- **Definitions:** "Low disk" means free space below `disk_low_free_pct: 10` on the latest snapshot. Fill rate is a straight-line fit over `disk_trend_horizon_days: 30`, with at least `disk_trend_min_points: 7` snapshots. The low-disk check only looks at the latest snapshot, so I judged "consistently low" from each device's daily history.
- **Same owner:** both devices belong to emp-initech-1000, so cleaning up both together with that user may be the quickest fix.
- **No actions proposed:** no action tools are available in this session. The evidence supports a disk cleanup or review of large files, starting with DARFCP0BQM2G, before considering a storage upgrade or replacement.
